Scenario fixture: binary-control-name-present (checkbox / radio / switch must have an accessible name)

Each target element has a stable id of the form binctl_case_NN. Native input[type=checkbox|radio] support <label> association but NOT content fallback (they have no renderable subtree content). ARIA role="switch", role="checkbox", and role="radio" DO support content fallback but do NOT resolve native <label> association (the rule only applies label resolution to native input controls).

A. Native input[type=checkbox]: mechanism priority order

01 — OUT OF SCOPE: native checkbox with no explicit role; form-control-programmatic-label-present reports it
02 — PASS: native checkbox, aria-label
03 — PASS: native checkbox, aria-labelledby
Accept terms
04 — PASS: native checkbox, title
05 — PASS: native checkbox, native <label for>
06 — PASS: native checkbox, wrapping <label>

B. Native input[type=radio]: mechanism priority order

07 — OUT OF SCOPE: native radio with no explicit role; form-control-programmatic-label-present reports it
08 — PASS: native radio, aria-label
09 — PASS: native radio, wrapping <label>

C. role="switch": content fallback allowed, no label resolution

10 — FAIL: role=switch, no name, no content
11 — PASS: role=switch, visible content (content fallback allowed)
Wi-Fi
12 — PASS: role=switch, aria-label
13 — FAIL: role=switch, wrapped by <label> (label association not resolved for ARIA-role kind)

D. role="checkbox" / role="radio" (ARIA-only): content fallback allowed

14 — PASS: role=checkbox, content
Gift wrap
15 — FAIL: role=checkbox, content is aria-hidden (does not count)
Insurance
16 — PASS: role=radio, content
Express shipping
17 — FAIL: role=radio, no name

E. Visible but excluded from AT (ineligible)

18 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: role=switch, aria-hidden="true", not natively focusable and no explicit tabindex, missing name
19 — EXCEPTION: aria-hidden="true" but focusable (tabindex=0) => excluded from naming rules (ACT: not included in the accessibility tree); aria-hidden-focus reports it
18b — EXCEPTION: native checkbox, aria-hidden="true", no explicit tabindex — native form controls are tabbable by default so this stays focusable, but naming rules do not apply (ACT: not included in the accessibility tree); aria-hidden-focus reports it

F. Hidden by HTML/CSS (ineligible)

20 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: hidden attribute
21 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: display:none
22 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: visibility:hidden
23 — OUT OF SCOPE: visibility:hidden ancestor overridden by descendant visibility:visible, so it is eligible, but a native checkbox with no explicit role belongs to form-control-programmatic-label-present

G. Inertness (ineligible)

24 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert on element itself
25 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert ancestor

End of fixture.
